firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 6 words, one filled primary + outline secondary, phone in header, Sample-labelled proof line, taped patch frame is the signature on screen; hero runs to ~890/900px so next band does not peek (-0.5); trade and city only in 12px eyebrow, not h1. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold.

distinctiveness.notes: Patch frame, feathered seams, drawn story panel, review swatch corners and 'Primed.' footer (1440-full.jpg) clearly differ from drywall/B 1440-first.jpg. 01-08 decorative numbering on services (1440-full.jpg, -0.5); the knife blade itself never appears in any screenshot, seams read as decoration.

type.notes: Hanken Grotesk 800 + Public Sans, tabular en-dash ranges in ledger (1440-scroll-50.jpg), curly quotes. Sizer status sentence set at display size, wraps mid-price (1440-scroll-50.jpg, -0.5); tracked caps eyebrow above every h2 (1440-full.jpg).

layout.notes: Tone steps alternate cleanly, full-bleed mud break, dense ledger (1440-full.jpg). Services left column empty ~700px (1440-full.jpg, -0.5); spruce-band and area h2 sit flush on their lists (1440-full.jpg, -0.5); reviews masonry leaves a 250px hole and padded empty card (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg: paper-tape hero framed as a taped patch, part of signature; mud close-up break (1440-full.jpg) one cool grade. Only video is a 190x110 thumbnail with pause button over ~40% of it (1440-rm-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg, -0.5).

copy.notes: Strong trade voice ('pin it, don't just caulk it', stain-blocking primer) and microcopy under form button (1440-full.jpg). Primary action named Price it / Price my patch / Price it x8 (1440-first.jpg, -0.5); 'Visit 1 · coat 0 of 3' counter bug (1440-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg); cracks h2 runs 3 lines at 1440 (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, full-width actions, Call/Text/Price it bar; story stacks without pin (390-full.jpg); render.json no overflow at 320/390. Hero photo stacked below buttons and cut by the sticky bar (390-first.jpg): collapsed, not re-cut; story video cropped to a 110px strip (390-full.jpg).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg shows all content as static cards; one h1, clean h2/h3 order, pause-video control, labelled inputs. Inactive story step labels ~2.3:1 on #E6E2D8 at ~12px (1440-scroll-25.jpg): mustFix, capped at 8.

motion.notes: Pinned 4-step story with the drawn wall changing per step (1440-scroll-25.jpg), sizer drawing, tabs, checklist, ZIP; reduced motion collapses cleanly (1440-rm-full.jpg). Blade sweep and ledger skim not visible in any frame (1440-scroll-50.jpg rows static), so the signature motion idea doesn't come across.

wow.notes: Patch sizer draws the hole size in a wall swatch with visits and dust note (1440-full.jpg); story tied to trade. Texture matcher 'Smooth' swatch is an empty gradient box (1440-full.jpg); sizer output is a text line plus a 40px square, not a keepable sheet.

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch, OG, print and forced-colors CSS, square radius held. Renee card SAMPLE REVIEW tag stretches full width and the 20px swatch corners look like broken images (1440-scroll-75.jpg, -0.5).

mustFix.problem: Inactive step labels ('VISIT 1', 'VISITS 2 AND 3', 'LAST VISIT') are ~2.3:1 on #E6E2D8 at ~12px; fails WCAG AA
mustFix.fix: Keep inactive labels at #50595D (5.54:1 on skim) and titles at least #4A5357; mark the inactive state with weight or a rule, never by fading the ink

elevate.move: Make the scroll's rough-to-smooth shape visible: feathered seams become clearly drawn knife edges that thin band by band to a straight rule at the form, and the services band's empty left column becomes a full-height drawn wall the knife has not passed yet

Replace the story's faded-ink inactive state with a material state: unpassed steps sit on rough board-gray texture with full-contrast text, the passed/active step on smooth primer, so the signature carries the state and every step stays AA
